# CI/CD & Supply Chain: Azure DevOps (ADO), GitHub Actions, ArgoCD & Binaries (`cicd-ado-github-argocd-supplychain`)

> **Group:** II. Identity, Gateways & Multi-Cloud / On-Prem
> **Product Archetypes:** CICD_Supply_Chain, Cloud_Infra_IaC
> **Trigger Signals:** azure-pipelines, ado, github/workflows, gitlab-ci, jenkinsfile, argocd, gitops, dockerfile, sbom, cosign, supplychain

## [ BLOCK: ado-and-github-actions-pipeline-injection ]
### Azure DevOps (ADO) & GitHub Actions Expression Injection & Token Permissions
- Check `.github/workflows/*.yml` and `azure-pipelines.yml` for dangerous triggers (`pull_request_target`), unpinned third-party actions/tasks (`@v*` instead of commit SHA), and missing `permissions:` blocks.
- Trace untrusted PR branch names, commit messages, or issue titles interpolated into `run:` / `script:` blocks.

## [ BLOCK: argocd-gitops-and-binary-provenance ]
### ArgoCD GitOps Control Plane & Prebuilt Binary / Dependency Provenance
- Verify authentication, RBAC, and webhook secret validation on ArgoCD (`argocd.ccar-internal`) and container registries.
- Flag unverified prebuilt native binaries (`.so`, `.dll`, `.onnx`) committed directly into repositories or downloaded in `setup.sh` without SHA-256 checksum pinning.

## [ BLOCK: pipeline-secret-masking-and-audit-tampering ]
### Pipeline Secret Leakage, Artifact Tampering & Audit Log Integrity
- Check build scripts for `env`, `printenv`, `set -x`, or verbose debug flags that dump CI/CD secrets into build logs.
- Verify whether build artifacts and container images are cryptographically signed (Cosign/SLSA) and verified before ArgoCD deployment.

### Standard Mappings
- SLSA-v1.0, NIST-SSDF, ASVS-5.0-V13-Configuration, ASVS-5.0-V14-Data-Protection, ASVS-5.0-V15-Secure-Coding-and-Architecture, ASVS-5.0-V16-Security-Logging-and-Error-Handling, CWE-78, CWE-494, CWE-829

### Safe Patterns (Refutation Anchors)
- GitHub Actions / ADO tasks pinned to full 40-char commit SHAs (uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683) with permissions: { contents: read }
- Untrusted PR metadata passed via env: { PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} } and referenced as "$PR_TITLE" in bash rather than inline ${{ ... }} interpolation
- SHA-256 checksum (sha256sum --check) and Cosign signature verification on all downloaded binaries, ONNX/VLA models, and container images before deployment
- Multi-stage Dockerfiles pinning base images by @sha256:... digest, running as non-root USER, and mounting build secrets via --mount=type=secret rather than ARG/ENV
- ArgoCD Application manifests restricted to specific targetRevision tags/commits, AppProject sourceRepos/destinations allowlists, and SSO + RBAC enforcement
- Package manager lockfiles enforced in CI (npm ci --ignore-scripts, pip install --require-hashes, go mod verify) with scoped registry configuration preventing dependency confusion

### Vulnerable Patterns
- on: pull_request_target workflow checking out untrusted PR head ref (ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}) and running npm install / pytest / build scripts with write tokens or cloud secrets
- Direct interpolation of ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} or $(System.PullRequest.SourceBranch) inside run: / script: shell blocks enabling arbitrary command injection
- curl -sSL https://.../install.sh | bash or unverified prebuilt .so / .dll / .onnx binaries committed or downloaded in Dockerfiles and setup.sh without cryptographic hash verification
- Dockerfile passing private registry tokens or SSH keys via ARG / ENV (persisted in image layer history) or running build steps without --ignore-scripts on public npm/PyPI packages
- CI/CD scripts executing set -x / printenv / env or echoing secret variables into build logs and artifact uploads
- ArgoCD configured with anonymous admin access enabled (users.anonymous.enabled: true) or auto-syncing mutable HEAD/latest tags from unverified external repositories

### Mandatory Evidence (`required_evidence`)
- ev_... excerpt of .github/workflows/*.yml, azure-pipelines.yml, .gitlab-ci.yml, or Jenkinsfile showing triggers, permissions, and shell steps
- ev_... excerpt of Dockerfile or setup/build scripts showing base image pinning, secret handling, and binary downloads
- ev_... excerpt of ArgoCD Application / AppProject manifest showing sourceRepos, targetRevision, and syncPolicy
- ev_... excerpt of dependency lockfile or artifact signature verification configuration

### Verification Questions When Static Code Is Inconclusive (`questions_when_unclear`)
- Are branch protection rules and mandatory code-owner reviews enforced on the repository before CI pipelines execute?
- Does an enterprise artifact proxy (Nexus/Artifactory) verify package signatures and block public dependency confusion upstream?
- Are self-hosted CI runners ephemeral and isolated per job, or persistent shared VMs with cached cloud credentials?
- Does Kubernetes admission control (Kyverno/Cosign policy-controller) block unsigned container images from deploying?
